children: Our Bureau Mumbai: Adani Power on Friday reported a 142% increase in its net profit in the July-September quarter, boosted by strong demand for electricity amid a weak monsoon season and an exceptional income. Profit after tax rose to 7,019.3 crore for second quarter from 2,906.5 crore a year earlier, the company said in a statement.

Operating revenue increased nearly 30% to 17,014.1 crore from 13,106.3 crore. Higher power production, an increase in tariffs under its power purchase agreements (PPAs) following a sharp rise in the price of imported coal, and improved realisation from selling electricity in the open market boosted revenue, Adani Power said.

Additionally, there was a prior-period revenue recognition of 2,422.2 crore the past quarter, primarily due to a revision in historic energy charges under certain PPAs, the company said. It had a similar income of 668.5 crore a year earlier. For the first half of the fiscal year, net profit rose more than 91% to 11,885.9 crore from 6,211.6 crore. The company said it is progressing rapidly on its capacity expansion programme to add 23,720 MW of new thermal power capacity.

title: Adani Power Profit Surges 142% on Strong Demand Amid Weak Rains
